# Mumbai demo: data and prediction check

Three **made-up people** whose check-ins are traced around Mumbai for six months (`app/services/demo.py`). Places are real Mumbai landmarks (9 coordinates verified on OpenStreetMap, the rest approximate to a few hundred metres); homes, offices, gyms and cafés are invented spots in real neighbourhoods. The app moves each history forward by whole weeks so it always ends in the past week.

| Person | Who | Check-ins | Places | Days | Furthest apart |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aarav Mehta | Software engineer. Lives in Powai, works in Bandra Kurla Complex | 551 | 14 | 182 | 15.6 km |
| Priya Nair | College student. Lives in Dadar, studies at St. Xavier's College | 890 | 19 | 182 | 12.4 km |
| Rohan Kapoor | Doctor. Lives in Bandra, works at Kokilaben Hospital, Andheri | 577 | 14 | 182 | 10.6 km |

Routines: **Aarav:** Weekday commute to BKC, gym on Mon/Wed/Fri, lake walks on Tue/Thu, Saturday morning runs, Sundays with his parents in Dadar, a work trip by air about every 5 weeks. **Priya:** Local train Dadar → CSMT on weekdays, library or Oval Maidan after class, Friday evenings on Marine Drive, Sunday temple visits and Shivaji Park. **Rohan:** Alternating day and evening shifts every other week (Mon–Sat), morning jogs on Carter Road, Sunday mass at Mount Mary then Linking Road and Juhu Beach.

## Scenario check

**14 of 14 scenarios pass**: the place the routine says comes next is in the algorithm's top 3. It is ranked **#1 in 9 of 14**. The algorithm's #1 also equals the place the person actually went to most often in that situation in 10 of 14.

## Replay on each person's own history

Same protocol as the main evaluation: walk the last 20% of the person's check-ins in time order; each prediction uses only earlier check-ins.

| Person | Method | Test check-ins | Top-1 | Top-3 | Top-5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aarav | Most visited (baseline) | 111 | 46.0% | 70.3% | 87.4% |
| Aarav | Markov only | 111 | 59.5% | 81.1% | 92.8% |
| Aarav | SyncroMove (full rule) | 111 | 74.8% | 92.8% | 99.1% |
| Priya | Most visited (baseline) | 178 | 34.8% | 76.4% | 85.4% |
| Priya | Markov only | 178 | 52.8% | 87.1% | 94.4% |
| Priya | SyncroMove (full rule) | 178 | 67.4% | 94.4% | 96.1% |
| Rohan | Most visited (baseline) | 116 | 56.9% | 71.5% | 80.2% |
| Rohan | Markov only | 116 | 62.1% | 82.8% | 92.2% |
| Rohan | SyncroMove (full rule) | 116 | 60.3% | 94.0% | 98.3% |

These people follow routines written to be learnable, so their accuracy is much higher than on real people. **The real-data result is in [EVALUATION.md](EVALUATION.md); quote that one.** This page shows that the algorithm picks up the patterns it is designed to pick up.
